height.description: Height of the latest decided block

amount.description:
Reward distributed per block, in wei (decimal string); absent when the node does not know
a reward for the epoch

baseFee.description: Smallest fee in wei per payload byte. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string

chainId.description: Espresso chain ID. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string rather than an integer

feeContract.description:
L1 fee contract; absent while fees are switched off, so that turning them off needs no
deployment

feeRecipient.description: Account credited with every sequencing fee, whether or not a fee contract is deployed

stakeTableContract.description:
L1 stake table proxy; absent while proof of stake is switched off, so that turning it off
needs no deployment

amount.description:
Circulating supply of ESP tokens on Ethereum L1, in ESP (decimal string):
total_supply_l1 - locked

Circulating supply in ESP (decimal string): initial_supply + reward_distributed -
locked, following the mainnet unlock schedule

variables.description: Only the variables the node's public-env-vars.toml allowlists

value.description: Empty when the variable is not set

Error.description: Error response following the Google API error model

account.description: Account charged for sequencing the block

amount.description: Fee paid in wei. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string

HeaderResponse.description:
The arm names the protocol version that produced the header. Versions sharing a shape share a
message: 0.2 uses the 0.1 shape and 0.6 the 0.5 shape

HeaderV1.description: The header shape introduced in protocol version 0.1, also used by 0.2

builderSignature.description:
Evidence that fee_info is correct. Absent when the builder did not sign, and never part of
the header commitment, since consensus has already checked it

l1Finalized.description: Latest L1 block finalized when the block was proposed; absent when none was

l1Head.description: L1 block this header was built against

HeaderV3.description: The header shape introduced in protocol version 0.3, which added the reward merkle tree

rewardMerkleTreeRoot.description: Root of the first reward merkle tree. TaggedBase64 `MERKLE_COMM~`

HeaderV4.description:
The header shape introduced in protocol version 0.4, which moved to the second reward merkle
tree and added millisecond timestamps, distributed rewards and the next stake table hash

nextStakeTableHash.description:
Stake table taking effect next epoch. TaggedBase64 `STAKE_TABLE~`. Absent outside an epoch
boundary

rewardMerkleTreeRoot.description:
Root of the second reward merkle tree, which replaced the first in this version.
TaggedBase64 `MERKLE_COMM~`

timestampMillis.description: Unix milliseconds, the precise form of timestamp

totalRewardDistributed.description: Rewards distributed since genesis, in wei. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string

HeaderV5.description:
The header shape introduced in protocol version 0.5, which added leader counts. Also used by
0.6

leaderCounts.description:
Times each validator led a view this epoch, indexed by its position in the stake table.
Always 100 entries, the cap on the active validator set

timestampMillis.description: Unix milliseconds, the precise form of timestamp

totalRewardDistributed.description: Rewards distributed since genesis, in wei. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string

HotshotConfigResponse.description:
The consensus parameters this node runs with. The bootstrap peer lists of the v1 endpoint are
not repeated here; stake tables have their own endpoints

builderTimeoutMs.description: Longest a leader waits for a builder's block before proposing without one

dataRequestDelayMs.description: Wait before requesting the data behind a proposal from peers

drbUpgradeDifficulty.description: Iterations of the DRB computation after the DRB upgrade

epochHeight.description: Blocks per epoch; zero before proof of stake

stakeTableCapacity.description: Stake table size the light-client circuit is built for

startProposingTime.description: Unix seconds from which this node proposes a consensus upgrade

startProposingView.description: View from which this node proposes a consensus upgrade

startThresholdNumerator.description: Share of stake that must be online before consensus starts, as a fraction

startVotingTime.description: Unix seconds from which this node votes for a consensus upgrade

startVotingView.description: View from which this node votes for a consensus upgrade

timestamp.description: Unix seconds, hex-encoded as on v1 rather than decimal

smallObjectRangeLimit.description:
Most objects one range query may load from the small-object class, which currently holds
leaves only: headers and block summaries are served by loading their whole block, and VID
common can be far larger than its parameters suggest, so both count as large objects

completedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; absent while the migration is still running

lastOffset.description: Offset of the last processed batch; absent before the first batch completes

nodeType.description: Binary name and version unless the operator overrode it

ethAccount.description: Ethereum account associated with this node, 0x-prefixed hex

x25519Key.description: X25519 public key for cliquenet, TaggedBase64

bytes.description: The namespace table in its canonical byte encoding, base64 in JSON

ResolvableChainConfig.description: A header carries either the chain config itself or a commitment the caller resolves elsewhere

missing.description: Number of missing objects, not counting pruned ones

ranges.description: Contiguous height ranges sharing one status, in ascending order

RuntimeConfigResponse.description:
The node's effective runtime configuration: CLI flags, environment and defaults merged. Tuning
parameters and the genesis stay on v1; secrets are never served

genesisFile.description: Path or URL the genesis was loaded from

l1ProviderCount.description: How many L1 RPC endpoints are configured; the URLs can carry credentials and are not served

StorageBackend.description: `STORAGE_BACKEND_FS_DEFAULT`: Filesystem storage with default settings, used when no storage flag was given

rate.description:
Fraction of views in which this node decided a block. Node-local, not a network measure.
Zero before the node has seen any view, so a fresh node reports zero rather than an
undefined ratio.

SyncStatus.description:
Whether this node stores an object, still has to fetch it, or deleted it on purpose
`SYNC_STATUS_MISSING`: Not stored yet; the node fetches it from peers in the background
`SYNC_STATUS_PRUNED`: Deleted by the pruner; the node will not fetch it again

end.description: Height just past the last one in the range (exclusive)

prunedHeight.description:
Height of the last pruned object: everything below it is pruned rather than missing. Absent
when nothing has been pruned

rowCount.description: Approximate live row count from the database's planner statistics; -1 when unknown

totalSizeBytes.description: On-disk size including indexes, in bytes; absent when the backend does not report it

seconds.description: Seconds elapsed since this node last decided a block

amount.description:
Total issued supply in ESP (decimal string): initial_supply +
total_reward_distributed, including rewards not yet claimed on Ethereum

Total supply of the ESP token minted on Ethereum, in ESP (decimal string);
excludes unclaimed rewards

Total rewards distributed by consensus, in ESP (decimal string), including rewards
not yet claimed on Ethereum

info.description: Generated from the proto definitions in crates/espresso/api/proto/v2. JSON follows canonical protoJSON: camelCase field names, 64-bit integers as decimal strings, bytes as base64, enums as their value names, oneofs flattened, defaults omitted. Query parameters accept both the proto field name and its camelCase form.
